crew.overview: Bacurau, a small town in the Brazilian sertão, mourns the loss of its matriarch, Carmelita, who lived to be 94. Days later, its inhabitants notice that their community has vanished from most maps.
crew.title: Bacurau

details.biography:
Emilie Natacha Lesclaux (Bordeaux) is a French film producer and political scientist based in Brazil.

She lives in Recife since 2002, where she married the filmmaker Kleber Mendonça Filho.  He has produced internationally awarded films such as Aquarius, O Som ao Redor and Bacurau.
details.name: Emilie Lesclaux
